teachings.SC4005: async is unavailable in this compilation mode; the host executes effects — declare a command instead.

fences.teaching: randomness is an effect: request it from the host and receive it as a Msg.
files are effects: declare reads and writes as commands the host executes.
network is an effect: declare requests as commands; responses arrive as Msgs.
machine identity is an effect: ask the host.
randomness and digests come from the host.
time is an effect: the host passes the clock in as a Msg.
process ambient state and authority belong to the host.
the monotonic clock is the host's.
